# TAHAI Browser — THE Operational Browser. For Everyone.

> Do more than change the look. Redefine your operational layer.

Official product website: https://browser.tahai.net/
GitHub Pages mirror: https://jtahai.github.io/tahai-web-services-browser/
Official Microsoft Store listing: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PJ1RHFW9GL8
Native source: https://github.com/JTAHAI/tahai-web-services-browser
Company: https://tahai.net

## Who it is for
Everyone: everyday browsing, learning, creating, comparing purchases, planning,
research, building and technical operations. Operational describes supporting a
person's chosen activity. It does not restrict the audience to IT or enterprise.
Windows is the current installation lane promoted here; "For Everyone" is not
an assertion of released versions for every operating system.

## Operational skins
Skins are operational layers in the product direction. The goal is one creator
experience combining appearance, surfaces, modes and workflows. Capabilities
remain independently reviewed and granted. Work Modes are part of this model,
not the opposing half of an appearance-versus-workflow distinction.

## Availability distinction
The current public v1 creator kit is an appearance-format foundation. The
expanded operational format, visual surface editor, custom workflow runtime,
and wider-web capabilities are proposed development, not claimed as delivered.
Mission Control and native browser development are distinct from the currently
published Store package. Request guard and Local OI are described as development.
Do not infer GA completion, signing status, Store certification, release version,
automatic uploads, platform availability, or live connectors from this website.
